The image presents a heatmap, denoted as Figure 4, which illustrates the experimental results of different combinations of positive and negative threshold values on the CCKS-IMLTC dataset. 

The heatmap's color bar, situated on the right side, ranges from 72 to 76, with a gradient transitioning from dark blue ( lowest value) to yellow (highest value). 

The x-axis is labeled "PST" and spans from 0.5 to 0.9, with increments of 0.1, while the y-axis is labeled "Pru" and also ranges from 0.5 to 0.9, with increments of 0.1. 

The heatmap itself comprises 25 squares, each displaying a numerical value. The squares are colored according to the color bar, with darker shades indicating lower values and lighter shades indicating higher values. Notably, the highest value, 76.140, is located at the intersection of PST = 0.7 and Pru = 0.6.
